confidence_notes: Restaurant and café anchors are holistic estimates of ordinary Florentine prices and are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and room rates vary widely. Drinks are estimated from typical Italian and Florentine bar pricing. FX provenance is weaker than the anchors: the 0.6947 USD per AUD figure for 2026-10-16 came from a third-party page that says it reproduces RBA mid-points, and I could not open or confirm that figure on the RBA page itself. Treat the FX value as unverified against the official table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of Florence as a high-demand Tuscan tourist city, benchmarked against Bologna, Siena and Pisa for everyday restaurants and cafés, with a premium applied to Florentine accommodation and bar prices for July peak demand. No live listings or booking pages were checked.
